expectations.text: Identifies the three-step loop: create worker entity, install into cluster, verify
expectations.evidence: Response is structured exactly as 'Create the worker entity', 'Install the worker into the kind cluster', 'Verify the worker is healthy'
Explicitly cites 'right choice for a dev cluster where you want ConfigHub-native apply (not Argo/Flux rendering)'
--namespace confighub in the composed install command
--wait present in the cub worker install invocation

expectations.text: Verifies via cub worker get + cub worker status + cub worker list-function
expectations.evidence: All three commands in the verification block, plus pod-level kubectl as fallback

expectations.text: Hands off to target-bind as the next step (not trying to apply from here)
expectations.evidence: 'Once that's green you're ready for target-bind (create a Target that points at this worker + a destination) and then cub-apply'

expectations.text: Does not hand-author the worker manifest
expectations.evidence: Uses cub worker install which generates the manifest; doesn't propose writing Deployment/SA/RBAC YAML by hand

expectations.text: Reads existing state (cub space list) to choose Space for worker
expectations.evidence: cub space list output shown and used to choose 'default' as the Space since none named 'workers' exists
